text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwoh!? Trainer, what in the world is 
that!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Right at the start of the New Year, 
there's a suspicious tent set up in front 
of Tracen Castle's gate...?!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year arrived, and No Reason had 
entered the Classic Year. However... it 
was quite a shocking start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overnight, a military encampment had been 
set up right in front of Tracen Academy's 
main gate.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that inside this tent is the 
enemy general seeking to conquer Tracen 
Academy...?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, attack! Before they bring us down, 
we'll bring them down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason lunges in with a fierce look on 
her face! And then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fngyaroro~, hangyaroro~! Welcome to my 
fortune-telling parlor!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You are... Lady Matikanefukukitaru?! Then, 
where are we...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is my fortune-telling tent. I 
was thinking of setting up shop in front 
of the school gate for New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems it wasn't enemy territory, 
just a traveling fortune teller's booth.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san, since you're here, why not 
have your New Year's fortune told?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
One: Fuji, Two: Hawk, Three: Eggplant~! 
I'm sure it'll bring a very auspicious 
result.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, is that so...? Then for good luck, 
let's have them take a look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to get our fortunes 
told, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Terrible Luck!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Aargh, cut them down! Cut them down!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyahiiii, have mercy~. I didn't do it on 
purpose~~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, how strange. Bad fortunes 
hardly ever come up around New Year's, and 
yet..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It looks like this year is going to be 
quite an ordeal for No Reason-san...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might not be accurate, but I wanted to 
know just in case.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What I see is... the number "3." It feels 
like all sorts of misfortune related to 3 
is going to happen...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
3? Speaking of 3... the first thing that 
comes to mind is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, and 
Kikuka Sho are truly races tied to the 
number 3. What's more...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because it's a race you can only run once 
in a lifetime, every camp is dead serious. 
Which makes trouble all the more likely to 
happen...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-san, please never let your guard 
down.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"If we know something might happen, we can 
prepare ourselves mentally, too..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: F-Fufufufu...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nowa-hahaha!! Mental preparation? What is 
there to fear?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing more tedious than a world 
where nothing happens. That would be far 
more dreadfully dull.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Bring on the suffering, bring on the 
chaos! In fact, it's getting me all fired 
up!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason laughed it off heartily. She 
wasn't the kind of Umamusume to be shaken 
by a mere fortune-telling result.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, Trainer. It seems this year shall 
be a fine ordeal for the both of us.
choice_data_list: A good trial... What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I know not what will unfold, but if you 
can weather it, you are the real deal.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Conversely, if we couldn't overcome it, 
then our bond amounted to only that much."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
By the time we enter the Senior Year... 
that connection might be severed clean 
through.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm. If it is their destiny to never walk 
together, such an outcome is possible.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, we are fleeting like the 
morning dew. As the saying goes, 'Meeting 
is the beginning of parting.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No Reason remained completely aloof and 
breezy. However...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's not that I want to cut ties. 
To deepen our bond and somehow overcome 
this—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Let us hold some manner of 
contest this New Year's.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It is only through a serious battle that 
warlords can truly understand one another!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A contest to deepen our bond. What should 
I do with No Reason?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, shogi, my specialty! And a seven-game 
match to boot, is it?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then just like a shogi title 
match, let us tour various inns and famous 
sights.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Let the seven-game match commence!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Match 1. A Noh theater in Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Match 2. A historic ryokan in Hokuriku.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ho-hoh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Match 3. A hotel in Kyushu.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: —Wait!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The battle dragged on all the way to the 
final round. And so, New Year's was spent 
fighting with No Reason in a clash of 
utmost wits and strategy."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, a relaxing Zen dialogue, is it? 
Perhaps secluding oneself in a temple once 
in a while wouldn't be so bad.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let us be off. Make ready, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this atmosphere... is quite soothing. 
It's ideal for letting one's thoughts 
wander.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come then, Trainer! Throw your questions 
at me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Deliverance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Zen riddle, the customary callouts. And 
then—
choice_data_list:
You can never have too many eggplants. 
Why, you ask?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What? Eggplants, you say? The more the 
better... Eggplants... Eggplants...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Snork... Fwaaah~! Whoa... so many... 
eggplants...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up falling asleep while thinking 
about it... In my dream, No Reason seemed 
to be surrounded by heaps of eggplants.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, it's not just a simple sword 
fight, but a battle of wits— that makes it 
all the better.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Then let us cross swords! An all-out sword 
match where anything goes!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Here I come! High-angle slash! ...Or so 
you thought, followed by—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Low block! Haah!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oho, splendidly dodged. Magnificent.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, come at me this time! Show me this 
clever scheme of yours!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'm not as skilled as No Reason. Even so, 
if I'm to catch them off guard—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A mid-level thrust! ...Or so you thought, 
but then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Beam Ray!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nowaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Like I'd let that come out, you fool!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah... Thou didst catch me off guard 
for a moment, however. Good, keep that 
momentum and come at me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, No Reason and I tried to outsmart 
each other in a fierce sword fight.
